question: Can a late instrumentation failure or write failure leave private SHA-pinned original C# partially adapted before .NET diagnostic?
baseline_provenance: Old scripts/verify_android_offline_candidate.py computed each instrumented text and immediately wrote it inside a for loop, without pre-validating later classes or restoring earlier originals.
approach: Validate all SHA pins and all original instrumentation plans first; write after preflight; on any source-write exception restore exact bytes of attempted originals in reverse order.
new_test_cases: Later instrument failure leaves both original sources byte-identical and .meta intact
second write raises after partial truncation and both original sources are rolled back
all validated source changes install successfully preserving unrelated SDK and .meta
source drift between selection and installation fails without writing
limitations: Rollback best-effort; severe disk failure can also prevent restoration
Not a transaction for later copies or generated harness failures
Does not prove original .rgd save/load schema in Unity
parallel: A1 water FFT, A2 display, A3/A6/A9 render, A7 touch and A8 DIAG-011 untouched
